description:
Analysis extent for Earthquake, Mexico, 19 September 2017 (EQ20170919MEX): 28 features merged from 4 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage Assessment in Central West Cuernavaca City, Municipality of Cuernavaca, State of Morelos](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-central-west-cuernavaca-city-municipality-of-cuernavaca-state-of-morelos)
- [Damage Assessment in Jojutla town, Jojutla Municipality, State of Morelos, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-jojutla-town-jojutla-municipality-state-of-morelos-mexico-2698)
- [Damage Assessment in Mexico City, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-mexico-city-mexico-2711)
- [Damage Assessment in San Andrés Cholula and San Pedro Cholula, State of Puebla, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-san-andres-cholula-and-san-pedro-cholula-state-of-puebla-mexico-2717)
- [Damage Assessment in Tlaquiltenango Town, Municipality of Tlaquiltenango, State of Morelos, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-tlaquiltenango-town-municipality-of-tlaquiltenango-state-of-morelos-mexico-2705)
- [Damage Assessment in Tlayacapan town, Municipality of Tlayacapan, State of Morelos, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-tlayacapan-town-municipality-of-tlayacapan-state-of-morelos-mexico-2707)
- [Damage Assessment in Xochimilco and Tlahuac Municipalities, Federal State, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-xochimilco-and-tlahuac-municipalities-federal-state-mexico-2712)
- [Damage Assessment in the Historical Center of Puebla, State of Puebla](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-the-historical-center-of-puebla-state-of-puebla-2700)
- [Damage Assessment in the south west of Cuauhtemoc Municipality, Federal District, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-the-south-west-of-cuauhtemoc-municipality-federal-district-mexico-2699)
- [Damage Assessment in the town of Atzala, Municipality of Atzala, State of Puebla, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-the-town-of-atzala-municipality-of-atzala-state-of-puebla-mexico)
- [Damage Assessment in the town of Coatetelco, Municipality of Miacatlan, State of Morelos, Mexico](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-the-town-of-coatetelco-municipality-of-miacatlan-state-of-morelos-mexico)
- [Evaluación de daño en la colonia Capultitlan, Ciudad de México](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/evaluacion-de-dano-en-la-colonia-capultitlan-ciudad-de-mexico-2713)
- and 1 more; the event's [catalog page](../catalog.json) lists them all.

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated; 5 = High; 6 = Low. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 53 = UAV (Phantom 4 Pro); 54 = Digital Globe; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 18 = AM; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 45 = MD; 54 = HP; 55 = VG; 57 = PG; 66 = CJ; 73 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 141 = KJP; 151 = MNY; 161 = DC; 171 = SR; 222 = CS; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
